engine: game/js/jukebox.js (installed from game/js/menus.js at boot; wraps music.pickRotationTrack/pickTrack)
note: Pools are defined ONCE here. music-library.json is NOT edited by this file's lane: the music-rotation lane (open PR #1030) owns that file, and jukebox.js reads its tracks at runtime, so the two lanes merge without touching the same JSON. A pool the user picks in Settings (JUKEBOX row, wh_settings_v1.jukebox) wins over stage rotation; 'default' delegates to music.js rotation untouched.
